text:
maria chen: Monitoring alert — sudden KV cache growth on prod-ingest for model-batch-7, combined with an uptick in stalled streaming sessions. Grafana: cache size +120% in 3min, token cadence latency spikes. :rotating_light:
ops-bot: Incident created (INC-2026-176900) — severity: high. Paging oncall (jia singh). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-paging
jia singh: I'm on it. First check: is continuous-batching feature flag on? Any recent deploys to runtime?
maria chen: Continuous batching was toggled on last night for canary. Deploy ID: deploy-20260314-1182. We pushed a small batching threshold tweak around 02:10 UTC.
jia singh: Ok pushing quick mitigations: 1) disable continuous batching for model-batch-7 2) temporarily reduce prefetch window to 0.3 3) force eviction to an aggressive policy. Doing step 1 now.
jia singh: Command I'm running:
```
# disable feature flag for the pool
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \\
  https://controlplane.internal/flags/continuous_batching -d '{"pool":"model-batch-7","enabled":false}'
```
thomas ng: I saw a correlated exception in the runtime logs earlier: streaming-latch hang where partial-flush goroutine waits on KV page fetch that never returns. Stack snippet:
```
runtime: goroutine 11234 [semacquire]:
  runtime.semasleep(0x...)
  github.com/redwood/serve/stream.(*Streamer).partialFlush(0xc01234...)
  ...
```
thomas ng: Looks like a regression in the KV prefetch backpressure introduced in the batching PR — fetch queue can block when cache growth + large batch size combine. Partial flush backoff logic didn't handle the blocked fetch case, leading to token cadence stalls.
ryan hall: Support: two customers reported degraded chat streaming: tokens stopped mid-response then resumed after ~6-8s, sometimes truncated final chunk. Customer IDs: cust-9412, cust-1127. No data loss, but UX bad. I've opened support tickets and flagged escalation.
jia singh: Disabling continuous batching complete. Rolling eviction and prefetch patch to all nodes in pool. Observability: KV cache growth has flattened, token cadence spikes reduced ~70% in preliminary metrics.
ops-bot: deploy-bot initiated hotfix rollout: hotfix/kv-prefetch-backpressure v1.0.1 -> 12 nodes. Progress: 6/12 succeeded.
deploy-bot: rollout logs:
```
[2026-03-15T03:08:10Z] cordon node-78
[2026-03-15T03:09:02Z] drain node-78
[2026-03-15T03:09:35Z] apply hotfix v1.0.1 to runtime container
[2026-03-15T03:10:12Z] uncordon node-78
```
thomas ng: The patch includes a fix to partialFlush to short-circuit when prefetch queue is stalled and to surface a backpressure metric. Also a small change to the eviction hysteresis to avoid oscillation during sudden growth.
maria chen: Good. Jia, after rollout completes can you validate streaming logs for the customer sessions (cust-9412) and confirm no truncations? Also run the regression eval suite against model-batch-7 with streaming load.
jia singh: Will do. Running a focused replay load now (500 streams/min for 10m) and checking partial flush counts.
[~6 minutes later]
jia singh: Replay run: partial-flush stalls dropped from ~42/min -> 3/min. Cache growth stable. I manually retried a couple of previously-stalled sessions for cust-9412 — streams completed normally, final tokens present.
ryan hall: Notifying those two customers with the incident summary and ETA on RCA. They want to know root cause and whether throttles persisted for other customers.
maria chen: Immediate customer impact: intermittent streaming stalls and sometimes truncated final tokens for a small subset of sessions routed to model-batch-7 while continuous batching + new prefetch heuristics were enabled. No data corruption. Duration: ~02:08–03:12 UTC (rough window). Estimated affected traffic: ~0.6% of streaming volume; 2 enterprise customers reported.
thomas ng: Next steps for RCA: 1) reproduce locally with a synthetic workload that mirrors observed sequence length distribution 2) audit prefetch queue metrics and add alert for fetch-queue-depth > 50 3) postmortem doc and PR link. I'll start on repro test.
jia singh: I'll prepare mitigation playbook updates: add immediate steps to disable batching per-pool, and a safer default for prefetch window.
ryan hall: Support will attach timeline and affected customers to the incident. I'll coordinate follow-up comms.
maria chen: Oncall handoff: I'm passing to thomas (runtime team) for deeper debugs and RCA. Jia will remain as SRE followup for mitigation updates. If anything degrades again escalate to execs.
thomas ng: Acknowledged — taking over. I'll post a preliminary RCA within 8 hours and a full postmortem in 48 hours.
maria chen: Thanks all. Closing the urgent phase; keeping incident open for RCA and customer comms. :white_check_mark:
